summary: Hyundai ABS Funding, LLC filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-D, a $1,997,210,000 auto-loan ABS issuance. Seven note classes price at 99.96840–100.00000% with coupons of 4.277% (A-1) to 5.49% (C), A-2-B floating at SOFR+0.40%; final maturities run November 2027 to February 2034. Credit enhancement includes a $5,121,063.97 reserve, subordination, and overcollateralization of $51,215,589.89 plus a $223,864,060.33 yield supplement amount. BNP Paribas, BofA, Scotiabank, Societe Generale and US Bancorp are joint bookrunners. Notes may be partially retained by HCA. This is ordinary securitization shelf takedown, not a special situation.
